# Phase Three — Final Track Architecture

The Awtsmoos is one before command, selection, cache, toolbar, and row become names;
Awtsmoos.com reveals each as a small vessel while the public gateway remains the same.

## Final source architecture

- Rewrite `ui/browser/tracks.js` as the stable public gateway with tab indentation and safe list replacement.
- Rewrite `tracks/styles.js` as a compatibility no-op documenting static CSS ownership.
- Rewrite `tracks/commands.js` around a small `ChesedTrackCommandFactory` while keeping exports.
- Rewrite `tracks/row.js` around `MalchusTrackRowFactory` and safe DOM.
- Rewrite `tracks/toolbar.js` around `TiferesEventToolbarFactory` and safe DOM.
- Rewrite `tracks/selection.js` around `YesodTrackSelectionController`, no HTML strings.
- Rewrite `tracks/cache.js` around `NetzachTrackCacheIndicator`, no HTML strings.
- Add `styles/runtime/track-browser-shell.css` for toolbar/row geometry.
- Add `styles/runtime/track-browser-controls.css` for buttons/checks/text.
- Add `styles/runtime/track-browser-interaction.css` for hover/active/focus-visible/disabled/saved/reduced-motion/mobile.
- Import all three from `styles/runtime-ui.css`.

## Verification graph

syntax -> line ceiling -> no runtime style factory -> no track innerHTML -> static import graph -> interaction-state scan -> diff check -> new track tests -> all Rebbe tests -> live route load -> remaining-work update -> next sitewide node.
